capabilities: Imports active and archived Todoist projects with their active tasks
Reconciles remote projects with local markdown files via tpt_ frontmatter properties
Creates a sample Bases view listing active projects
Auto-imports projects on a configurable background schedule
Applies Todoist project and label colors in Bases formulas
disambiguation: Not a two-way sync or task manager: it only reads from Todoist and never writes anything back.
extras: Read-only towards Todoist; no telemetry; API token kept in Obsidian secret storage per device; stylesheet class and variable names may change before version 1.0.
problem: Todoist project status lives outside the vault, so there is no way to see or query it alongside your notes in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: The plugin connects to the Todoist API (api.todoist.com) and nowhere else.
It requires the Bases core plugin.

summary: Read-only Todoist integration that imports projects, tasks and labels into vault markdown files with tpt_ properties for status tracking.
